decisions.reason: The archiving and reporting software is central to the firm's automation software core and its move toward data-driven infrastructure management, so the firm can interpret and refine it with its own R&D.
It draws on the same software knowledge as A but has always had low visibility, so it may be consolidated, yet it still fits the firm's capabilities and costs little to maintain.

The floating sludge extractor builds directly on the firm's wastewater tank equipment know-how and serves its core utility customers, making it a low-risk niche addition.

The flow measurement automation software is close to the firm's software and measurement expertise and supports its connected, predictive operation strategy, so the firm can learn from its results and improve it.
